articles.title: A quantum roadmap would push Bitcoin much higher: Charles Edwards
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin development roadmap that addresses quantum computing risks could see the price surge by “double digits” very quickly, according to Charles Edwards.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin's New $15M Quantum Defense Fund
articles.snippet: Plus, the Clarity Act is no longer expected to progress before the August recess. And Vlad Tenev's X was hacked to post a meme coin...

articles.title: BlackRock, Coinbase and Strategy Pledge $15M to Quantum-Proof Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Nine of the biggest institutional names in Bitcoin formed a consortium to fund the developers working to keep the network secure—including from future quantum computers.
